events.text:
I can only generate at 1:1, 16:9, or 9:16, so 4:5 has to come from editing an existing image. The edit tool does accept 4:5 but needs an input image, so the plan would be to generate at 1:1 and then edit it into 4:5. That means two jobs and two sets of credits.

I'm weighing a second route: asking the user instead of editing. Text may not render well on the free model, so I'm considering generating a base image at 1:1 with headroom at the top and adding the text in the 4:5 edit. On the free plan that means one generation at 640px with flux-2-klein, so the prompt needs to leave space at the top.
